sections.label: Book 8
sections.name: The evening pressing, the purifying bath and Soma rites

verses.sa: उपयामगृहीतोऽस्यादित्येभ्यस्त्वा। विष्ण उरुगायैष ते सोमस्तं रक्षस्व मा त्वा दभन्॥
verses.tr: upayāmagṛhīto'syādityebhyastvā viṣṇa urugāyaiṣa te somastaṃ rakṣasva mā tvā dabhan
verses.en: Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Adityas. Here, O Far-striding Vishnu, is thy Soma. Guard it from injury. Let them not harm thee.

verses.sa: कदा चन स्तरीरसि नेन्द्र सश्चसि दाशुषे। उपोपेन्नु मघवन् भूय इन्नु ते दानं देवस्य पृच्यत आदित्येभ्यस्त्वा॥
verses.tr: kadā cana starīrasi nendra saścasi dāśuṣe upopennu maghavan bhūya innu te dānaṃ devasya pṛcyata ādityebhyastvā
verses.en: Ne'er art thou fruitless, Indra; ne'er dost thou desert thy worshipper.- But now, O Liberal Lord, thy bounty as a God is poured forth ever more and more. Thee for the Adityas.

verses.sa: कदा चन प्र युच्छस्युभे नि पासि जन्मनी। तुरीयादित्य सवनं त इन्द्रियमातस्थावमृतं दिव्यादित्येभ्यस्त्वा॥
verses.tr: kadā cana pra yucchasyubhe ni pāsi janmanī turīyāditya savanaṃ ta indriyamātasthāvamṛtaṃ divyādityebhyastvā
verses.en: Never art thou neglectful: thou guardest both races with thy care. The Soma feast, O Fourth Aditya, is thy strength. Amrit is stablished in the heavens. Thee for the Adityas.

verses.sa: यज्ञो देवानां प्रत्येति सुम्नमादित्यासो भवता मृडयन्तः। आ वोऽर्वाची सुमतिर्ववृत्यादहोश्चिद्या वरिवोवित्तरासदादित्येभ्यस्त्वा॥
verses.tr: yajño devānāṃ pratyeti sumnamādityāso bhavatā mṛḍayantaḥ ā vo'rvācī sumatirvavṛtyādahościdyā varivovittarāsadādityebhyastvā
verses.en: The sacrifice obtains the Gods' acceptance. Be graciously inclined to us, Adityas. Hitherward let your favour be directed and be our best deliverer from trouble. Thee for the Adityas.

verses.sa: विवस्वन्नादित्यैष ते सोमपीथस्तस्मिन् मत्स्व। श्रदस्मै नरो वचसे दधातन यदाशीर्दा दम्पती वाममश्नुतः। पुमान् पुत्रो जायते विन्दते वस्वधा विश्वाहारप एधते गृहे॥
verses.tr: vivasvannādityaiṣa te somapīthastasmin matsva śradasmai naro vacase dadhātana yadāśīrdā dampatī vāmamaśnutaḥ pumān putro jāyate vindate vasvadhā viśvāhārapa edhate gṛhe
verses.en: This is thy Soma draught, O bright Aditya: take delight therein. To this mine utterance, O ye men, give credence, what good the man and wife obtain by praying: A manly son is born and gathers riches, and thrives for ever sinless in the dwelling.

verses.sa: वाममद्य सवितर्वाममु श्वो दिवे दिवे वाममस्मभ्यं सावीः। वामस्य हि क्षयस्य देव भूरेरया धिया वामभाजः स्याम॥
verses.tr: vāmamadya savitarvāmamu śvo dive dive vāmamasmabhyaṃ sāvīḥ vāmasya hi kṣayasya deva bhūrerayā dhiyā vāmabhājaḥ syāma
verses.en: Fair wealth, O Savitar, to-day, to-morrow, fair wealth produce for us each day that passes. May we, through this our song, be happy gainers, God! of a fair and spacious habitation.

verses.sa: उपयामगृहीतोऽसि सावित्रोऽसि चनोधाश्चनोधा असि चनो मयि धेहि। जिन्व यज्ञं जिन्व यज्ञपतिं भगाय देवाय त्वा सवित्रे॥
verses.tr: upayāmagṛhīto'si sāvitro'si canodhāścanodhā asi cano mayi dhehi jinva yajñaṃ jinva yajñapatiṃ bhagāya devāya tvā savitre
verses.en: Taken upon a base art thou. Savitar's giver of delight art thou. Giver of joy art thou: vouchsafe me joy. Speed thou the sacrifice, speed thou the sacrifice's lord to win his share. Thee for the God, for Savitar.

verses.sa: उपयामगृहीतोऽसि सुशर्माऽसि सुप्रतिष्ठानो बृहदुक्षाय नमः। विश्वेभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्य एष ते योनिर्विश्वेभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: upayāmagṛhīto'si suśarmā'si supratiṣṭhāno bṛhadukṣāya namaḥ viśvebhyastvā devebhya eṣa te yonirviśvebhyastvā devebhyaḥ
verses.en: Taken upon a base art thou. Thou art a good protector, firmly stablished. To the Great Bull be reverential homage. Thee for the Visvedevas. This is thy home: Thee for the Visvedevas.

verses.sa: उपयामगृहीतोऽसि बृहस्पतिसुतस्य देव सोम त इन्दोरिन्द्रियावतः पत्नीवतो ग्रहाँ२ ऋध्यासम्। अहं परस्तादहमवस्ताद्यदन्तरिक्षं तदु मे पिताऽभूत्। अहं सूर्यमुभयतो ददर्शाहं देवानां परमं गुहा यत्॥
verses.tr: upayāmagṛhīto'si bṛhaspatisutasya deva soma ta indorindriyāvataḥ patnīvato grahāṃ2 ṛdhyāsam ahaṃ parastādahamavastādyadantarikṣaṃ tadu me pitā'bhūt ahaṃ sūryamubhayato dadarśāhaṃ devānāṃ paramaṃ guhā yat
verses.en: Taken upon a base art thou. May it be mine to prosper the libations of thee Brihaspati's son, O radiant Soma, of thee, strong Indu, mated with thy Consorts. I am in heaven above, on earth beneath it. The intermediate, region was my father. I saw the Sun both from above and under. I am what Gods in secret hold the highest.

verses.sa: अग्ना३इ पत्नीवन्त्सजूर्देवेन त्वष्ट्रा सोमं पिब स्वाहा। प्रजापतिर्वृषाऽसि रेतोधा रेतो मयि धेहि प्रजापतेस्ते वृष्णो रेतोधसो रेतोधामशीय॥
verses.tr: agnā3i patnīvantsajūrdevena tvaṣṭrā somaṃ piba svāhā prajāpatirvṛṣā'si retodhā reto mayi dhehi prajāpateste vṛṣṇo retodhaso retodhāmaśīya
verses.en: Agni, associate with the Dames, accordant with the God Tvashtar, drink. All-hail! Thou art Prajapati, strong male, impregner: may I obtain from thee, strong made, impregner, a son who shall him self become a father.

verses.sa: उपयामगृहीतोऽसि हरिरसि हारियोजनो हरिभ्यां त्वा। हर्योर्धाना स्थ सहसोमा इन्द्राय॥
verses.tr: upayāmagṛhīto'si harirasi hāriyojano haribhyāṃ tvā haryordhānā stha sahasomā indrāya
verses.en: Taken upon a base art thou. Thou art bay-coloured, Yoker of Bay Coursers. Thee for the pair of tawny-coloured horses. United with the Soma, ye, for Indra, are corn for his two tawny steeds to feed on.

verses.sa: यस्ते अश्वसनिर्भक्षो यो गोसनिस्तस्य त इष्टयजुष स्तुतसोमस्य शस्तोक्थस्योपहूतस्योपहूतो भक्षयामि॥
verses.tr: yaste aśvasanirbhakṣo yo gosanistasya ta iṣṭayajuṣa stutasomasya śastokthasyopahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi
verses.en: That draught of thine which winneth cows or horses, offered with sacrificial text and lauded. With chanted hymns and songs of adoration—of that permitted do I take permitted.

verses.sa: देवकृतस्यैनसोऽवयजनमसि मनुष्यकृतस्यैनसोऽवयजनमसि पितृकृतस्यैनसोऽवयजनमस्यात्मकृतस्यैनसोऽवयजनमस्येनस एनसोऽवयजनमसि। यच्चाहमेनो विद्वाँश्चकार यच्चाविद्वाँस्तस्य सर्वस्यैनसोऽवयजनमसि॥
verses.tr: devakṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasi manuṣyakṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasi pitṛkṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasyātmakṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasyenasa enaso'vayajanamasi yaccāhameno vidvāṃścakāra yaccāvidvāṃstasya sarvasyainaso'vayajanamasi
verses.en: Of sin against the Gods thou art atonement. Of sin against mankind thou art atonement. For sin against the Fathers thou atonest. Of sin against oneself thou art atonement. Of every sort of sin thou art atonement. The sin that I have knowingly committed, the sin that unawares I have committed, of all that wickedness thou art the atonement.

verses.sa: सं वर्चसा पयसा सं तनूभिरगन्महि मनसा सं शिवेन। त्वष्टा सुदत्रो वि दधातु रायोऽनुमार्ष्टु तन्वो यद्विलिष्टम्॥
verses.tr: saṃ varcasā payasā saṃ tanūbhiraganmahi manasā saṃ śivena tvaṣṭā sudatro vi dadhātu rāyo'numārṣṭu tanvo yadviliṣṭam
verses.en: We with our bodies have again united, with lustre, vital sap, and happy spirit. Giver of boons, may Tvashtar grant us riches and smooth whatever was injured in our body.

verses.sa: समिन्द्र णो मनसा नेषि गोभिः सं सूरिभिर्मघवन्त्सं स्वस्त्या। सं ब्रह्मणा देवकृतं यदस्ति सं देवानां सुमतौ यज्ञियानां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: samindra ṇo manasā neṣi gobhiḥ saṃ sūribhirmaghavantsaṃ svastyā saṃ brahmaṇā devakṛtaṃ yadasti saṃ devānāṃ sumatau yajñiyānāṃ svāhā
verses.en: Lead us with thought to wealth in kine, O Indra, to princes. Lord of Bounty! and to welfare. Lead thou us on to God-inspired devotion, to favour of the Gods who merit worship. All-hail!

verses.sa: सं वर्चसा पयसा सं तनूभिरगन्महि मनसा सं शिवेन। त्वष्टा सुदत्रो वि दधातु रायोऽनुमार्ष्टु तन्वो यद्विलिष्टम्॥
verses.tr: saṃ varcasā payasā saṃ tanūbhiraganmahi manasā saṃ śivena tvaṣṭā sudatro vi dadhātu rāyo'numārṣṭu tanvo yadviliṣṭam
verses.en: Verse 14 repeated.

verses.sa: धाता रातिः सवितेदं जुषन्तां प्रजापतिर्निधिपा देवो अग्निः। त्वष्टा विष्णुः प्रजया संरराणा यजमानाय द्रविणं दधात स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: dhātā rātiḥ savitedaṃ juṣantāṃ prajāpatirnidhipā devo agniḥ tvaṣṭā viṣṇuḥ prajayā saṃrarāṇā yajamānāya draviṇaṃ dadhāta svāhā
verses.en: May this please Savitar and liberal Dhatar, Prajapati the Treasure-Guard, bright Agni, Tvashtar, and Vishnu: blessing him with children, grant store of riches to the Sacrificer.

verses.sa: सुगा वो देवाः सदना अकर्म य आजग्मेदं सवनं जुषाणाः। भरमाणा वहमाना हवींष्यस्मे धत्त वसवो वसूनि स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: sugā vo devāḥ sadanā akarma ya ājagmedaṃ savanaṃ juṣāṇāḥ bharamāṇā vahamānā havīṃṣyasme dhatta vasavo vasūni svāhā
verses.en: Gods, we have made your seats easy of access, who, pleased with us, have come to this libation. Bearing and bringing hitherward your treasures, grant to this man, good Lords, abundant riches. All-hail!

verses.sa: याँ२ आऽवह उशतो देव देवाँस्तान् प्रेरय स्वे अग्ने सधस्थे। जक्षिवांसः पपिवांसश्च विश्वेऽसुं घर्मं स्वरातिष्ठतानु स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yāṃ2 ā'vaha uśato deva devāṃstān preraya sve agne sadhasthe jakṣivāṃsaḥ papivāṃsaśca viśve'suṃ gharmaṃ svarātiṣṭhatānu svāhā
verses.en: The willing Gods whom, God, thou hast brought hither, send them to their own dwelling-place, O Agni.' As all of you have eaten and have drunken, approach the air, the heat, the light of heaven.

verses.sa: वयं हि त्वा प्रयति यज्ञे अस्मिन्नग्ने होतारमवृणीमहीह। ऋधगया ऋधगुताशमिष्ठाः प्रजानन् यज्ञमुप याहि विद्वान्त्स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ hi tvā prayati yajñe asminnagne hotāramavṛṇīmahīha ṛdhagayā ṛdhagutāśamiṣṭhāḥ prajānan yajñamupa yāhi vidvāntsvāhā
verses.en: Here, Agni, as this sacrifice proceedeth, have we elected thee to be our Hotar. Special have been thine offerings and thy labour. Well knowing sacrifice, as sage, come near us.

verses.sa: देवा गातुविदो गातुं वित्त्वा गातुमित। मनसस्पत इमं देव यज्ञं स्वाहा वाते धाः॥
verses.tr: devā gātuvido gātuṃ vittvā gātumita manasaspata imaṃ deva yajñaṃ svāhā vāte dhāḥ
verses.en: Do ye, O Gods, discoverers of the Pathway, go forward on the path when ye have found it. O God, thou Lord and Master of the Spirit, bestow—All-hail!—this sacrifice on Vrata.

verses.sa: यज्ञ यज्ञं गच्छ यज्ञपतिं गच्छ स्वां योनिं गच्छ स्वाहा। एष ते यज्ञो यज्ञपते सहसूक्तवाकः सर्ववीरस्तं जुषस्व स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yajña yajñaṃ gaccha yajñapatiṃ gaccha svāṃ yoniṃ gaccha svāhā eṣa te yajño yajñapate sahasūktavākaḥ sarvavīrastaṃ juṣasva svāhā
verses.en: Go, Sacrifice, to the sacrifice: seek thou the sacrifice's lord, seek thine own home. All-hail! Lord of the sacrifice, this is thy sacrifice, followed by many heroes, loud with hymns of praise. Accept it thou. All hail!

verses.sa: माहिर्भूर्मा पृदाकुः। उरुं हि राजा वरुणश्चकार सूर्याय पन्थामन्वेतवा उ। अपदे पादा प्रतिधातवेऽकरुतापवक्ता हृदयाविधश्चित्। नमो वरुणायाभिष्ठितो वरुणस्य पाशः॥
verses.tr: māhirbhūrmā pṛdākuḥ uruṃ hi rājā varuṇaścakāra sūryāya panthāmanvetavā u apade pādā pratidhātave'karutāpavaktā hṛdayāvidhaścit namo varuṇāyābhiṣṭhito varuṇasya pāśaḥ
verses.en: Become no serpent thou, become no viper. King Varuna hath made a spacious pathway, a pathway for the Sun wherein to travel. Where no way as he made him set his footstep, and warned afar whate'er afflicts the spirit. To Varuna be reverential homage! Varuna's noose beneath our feet is trampled.

verses.sa: अग्नेरनीकमप आ विवेशापां नपात् प्रतिरक्षन्नसुर्यम्। दमेदमे समिधं यक्ष्यग्ने प्रति ते जिह्वा घृतमुच्चरण्यत् स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: agneranīkamapa ā viveśāpāṃ napāt pratirakṣannasuryam damedame samidhaṃ yakṣyagne prati te jihvā ghṛtamuccaraṇyat svāhā
verses.en: The waters, face of Agni, have I entered, O Waters' Child, repelling evil spirits. Offer the fuel in each home, O Agni. Let thy tongue dart—All-hail!—to meet the butter.

verses.sa: समुद्रे ते हृदयमप्स्वन्तः सं त्वा विशन्त्वोषधीरुतापः। यज्ञस्य त्वा यज्ञपते सूक्तोक्तौ नमोवाके विधेम यत्स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: samudre te hṛdayamapsvantaḥ saṃ tvā viśantvoṣadhīrutāpaḥ yajñasya tvā yajñapate sūktoktau namovāke vidhema yatsvāhā
verses.en: Thy heart is in the flood, within the waters. With thee let plants and waters be commingled, That, Lord of Sacrifice, we may adore thee with singing praise and telling forth our homage. All-hail!

verses.sa: देवीराप एष वो गर्भस्तं सुप्रीतं सुभृतं बिभृत। देव सोमैष ते लोकस्तस्मिञ्छं च वक्ष्व परि च वक्ष्व॥
verses.tr: devīrāpa eṣa vo garbhastaṃ suprītaṃ subhṛtaṃ bibhṛta deva somaiṣa te lokastasmiñchaṃ ca vakṣva pari ca vakṣva
verses.en: This, O celestial Waters, is your offspring. Support him dearly loved and gently nurtured. This is thy station, O celestial Soma; therein bring happiness and ward of evil.

verses.sa: अवभृथ निचुम्पुण निचेरुरसि निचुम्पुणः। अव देवैर्देवकृतमेनोऽयासिषमव मर्त्यैर्मर्त्यकृतं पुरुराव्णो देव रिषस्पाहि। देवानां समिदसि॥
verses.tr: avabhṛtha nicumpuṇa nicerurasi nicumpuṇaḥ ava devairdevakṛtameno'yāsiṣamava martyairmartyakṛtaṃ pururāvṇo deva riṣaspāhi devānāṃ samidasi
verses.en: O 2^7 restless Purifying Bath, thou glidest onward restlessly. May I with aid of Gods remove the stain of sin against the Gods, and wash away with mortals' help the wrong that hath been done to men. Preserve me, God, from injury, from the loud-roaring demon foe. Thou art the fuel of the Gods.

verses.sa: एजतु दशमास्यो गर्भो जरायुणा सह। यथाऽयं वायुरेजति यथा समुद्र एजति। एवायं दशमास्यो अस्रज्जरायुणा सह॥
verses.tr: ejatu daśamāsyo garbho jarāyuṇā saha yathā'yaṃ vāyurejati yathā samudra ejati evāyaṃ daśamāsyo asrajjarāyuṇā saha
verses.en: Let, still unborn, the ten-month calf move with the following after-birth. Even as the wind is moving, as the gathered flood of ocean moves, So may this ten-month calf come forth together with the after-birth.

verses.sa: यस्यै ते यज्ञियो गर्भो यस्यै योनिर्हिरण्यी। अङ्गान्यह्रुता यस्य तं मात्रा समजीगमं स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yasyai te yajñiyo garbho yasyai yonirhiraṇyī aṅgānyahrutā yasya taṃ mātrā samajīgamaṃ svāhā
verses.en: O d thou who hast a womb of gold and offspring meet for sacrifice, Him with all limbs unbroken have I brought together with 'V his dam. All! -hail!

verses.sa: पुरुदस्मो विषुरूप इन्दुरन्तर्महिमानमानञ्ज धीरः। एकपदीं द्विपदीं त्रिपदीं चतुष्पदीमष्टापदीं भुवनानु प्रथन्तां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: purudasmo viṣurūpa indurantarmahimānamānañja dhīraḥ ekapadīṃ dvipadīṃ tripadīṃ catuṣpadīmaṣṭāpadīṃ bhuvanānu prathantāṃ svāhā
verses.en: Multiform, rich in wondrous operation, the strong juice hath enrobed itself with greatness. Let the worlds praise her uniped and biped, three-footed and four-footed and eight-footed. All-hail!

verses.sa: मरुतो यस्य हि क्षये पाथा दिवो विमहसः। स सुगोपातमो जनः॥
verses.tr: maruto yasya hi kṣaye pāthā divo vimahasaḥ sa sugopātamo janaḥ
verses.en: Verily, best of guardians hath he in whose dwelling-place ye drink, O Maruts, giants of the sky.

verses.sa: मही द्यौः पृथिवी च न इमं यज्ञं मिमिक्षताम्। पिपृतां नो भरीमभिः॥
verses.tr: mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca na imaṃ yajñaṃ mimikṣatām pipṛtāṃ no bharīmabhiḥ
verses.en: May Heaven and Earth, the Mighty Pair, besprinkle this our sacrifice, And feed us full with nourishments.

verses.sa: आ तिष्ठ वृत्रहन्रथं युक्ता ते ब्रह्मणा हरी। अर्वाचीनं सु ते मनो ग्रावा कृणोतु वग्नुना। उपयामगृहीतोऽसीन्द्राय त्वा षोडशिन एष ते योनिरिन्द्राय त्वा षोडशिने॥
verses.tr: ā tiṣṭha vṛtrahanrathaṃ yuktā te brahmaṇā harī arvācīnaṃ su te mano grāvā kṛṇotu vagnunā upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā ṣoḍaśina eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā ṣoḍaśine
verses.en: Slayer of Vritra, mount thy car: thy Bay Steeds have been yoked by prayer. May, with its voice, the pressing-stone draw thine attention hitherward. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra thee, for Shodasin. This is a dwelling-place for thee. For Indra thee, for Shodasin.

verses.sa: युक्ष्वा हि केशिना हरी वृषणा कक्ष्यप्रा। अथा न इन्द्र सोमपा गिरामुपश्रुतिं चर। उपयामगृहीतोऽसीन्द्राय त्वा षोडशिन एष ते योनिरिन्द्राय त्वा षोडशिने॥
verses.tr: yukṣvā hi keśinā harī vṛṣaṇā kakṣyaprā athā na indra somapā girāmupaśrutiṃ cara upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā ṣoḍaśina eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā ṣoḍaśine
verses.en: Harness thy pair of strong Bay Steeds, long-maned, whose bodies fill the girths, And, Indra, Soma-drinker, come to listen to our songs of praise. Taken upon a base, etc., as in

verses.sa: इन्द्रमिद्धरी वहतोऽप्रतिधृष्टशवसम्। ऋषीणां च स्तुतीरुप यज्ञं च मानुषाणाम्। उपयामगृहीतो सीन्द्राय त्वा षोडशिने एष ते योनिरिन्द्राय त्वा षोडशिने॥
verses.tr: indramiddharī vahato'pratidhṛṣṭaśavasam ṛṣīṇāṃ ca stutīrupa yajñaṃ ca mānuṣāṇām upayāmagṛhīto sīndrāya tvā ṣoḍaśine eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā ṣoḍaśine
verses.en: His pair of tawny Coursers bring Indra of unresisted might Hither to laishis' songs of praise and sacrifice performed by men. Taken upon a base, etc., as in

verses.sa: यस्मान्न जातः परो अन्यो अस्ति य आविवेश भुवनानि विश्वा। प्रजापतिः प्रजया संरराणस्त्रीणि ज्योतींषि सचते स षोडशी॥
verses.tr: yasmānna jātaḥ paro anyo asti ya āviveśa bhuvanāni viśvā prajāpatiḥ prajayā saṃrarāṇastrīṇi jyotīṃṣi sacate sa ṣoḍaśī
verses.en: Than whom there is none other born more mighty, who hath pervaded all existing creatures—Prajapati, rejoicing in his offspring, he, Shodasin, maintains the three great lustres.

verses.sa: इन्द्रश्च सम्राड्वरुणश्च राजा तौ ते भक्षं चक्रतुरग्र एतम्। तयोरहमनु भक्षं भक्षयामि वाग्देवी जुषाणा सोमस्य तृप्यतु सह प्राणेन स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: indraśca samrāḍvaruṇaśca rājā tau te bhakṣaṃ cakraturagra etam tayorahamanu bhakṣaṃ bhakṣayāmi vāgdevī juṣāṇā somasya tṛpyatu saha prāṇena svāhā
verses.en: Indra chief Lord and Varuna the Sovran have made this draught of thine the first and foremost. I, after, drink their draught. May she, the Goddess of Speech, rejoicing, sate herself with Soma—- All-hail!—1—with Prana as her feast-companion.

verses.sa: अग्ने पवस्व स्वपा अस्मे वर्चः सुवीर्यम्। दधद्रयिं मयि पोषम्। उपयामगृहीतोऽस्यग्नये त्वा वर्चस एष ते योनिरग्नये त्वा वर्चसे। अग्ने वर्चस्विन्वर्चस्वाँस्त्वं देवेष्वसि वर्चस्वानहं मनुष्येषु भूयासम्॥
verses.tr: agne pavasva svapā asme varcaḥ suvīryam dadhadrayiṃ mayi poṣam upayāmagṛhīto'syagnaye tvā varcasa eṣa te yoniragnaye tvā varcase agne varcasvinvarcasvāṃstvaṃ deveṣvasi varcasvānahaṃ manuṣyeṣu bhūyāsam
verses.en: Skilled in thy task, O Agni, pour lustre and hero strength on us, Granting me wealth and affluence. Taken upon a base art thou. For Agni thee, for splendour. This is thy home. For Agni thee, for splendour. Thou, lustrous Agni, mid the Gods art splendid. May I among mankind be bright with lustre.

verses.sa: उत्तिष्ठन्नोजसा सह पीत्वी शिप्रे अवेपयः। सोममिन्द्र चमू सुतम्। उपयामगृहीतोऽसीन्द्राय त्वौजस एष ते योनिरिन्द्राय त्वौजसे। इन्द्रौजिष्ठौजिष्ठस्त्वं देवेष्वस्योजिष्ठोऽहं मनुष्येषु भूयासम्॥
verses.tr: uttiṣṭhannojasā saha pītvī śipre avepayaḥ somamindra camū sutam upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvaujasa eṣa te yonirindrāya tvaujase indraujiṣṭhaujiṣṭhastvaṃ deveṣvasyojiṣṭho'haṃ manuṣyeṣu bhūyāsam
verses.en: Arising in thy might thy jaws thou shookest, Indra, having drunk. The Soma which the mortar pressed. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra thee, for mighty strength. This is thy home. For Indra thee, for might. Among the Gods thou art the mightiest, Indra. Among mankind I fain would be most mighty.

verses.sa: अदृश्रमस्य केतवो वि रश्मयो जनाँ२ अनु। भ्राजन्तो अग्नयो यथा। उपयामगृहीतोऽसि सूर्याय त्वा भ्राजायैष ते योनिः सूर्याय त्वा भ्राजाय। सूर्य भ्राजिष्ठ भ्राजिष्ठस्त्वं देवेष्वसि भ्राजिष्ठोऽहं मनुष्येषु भूयासम्॥
verses.tr: adṛśramasya ketavo vi raśmayo janāṃ2 anu bhrājanto agnayo yathā upayāmagṛhīto'si sūryāya tvā bhrājāyaiṣa te yoniḥ sūryāya tvā bhrājāya sūrya bhrājiṣṭha bhrājiṣṭhastvaṃ deveṣvasi bhrājiṣṭho'haṃ manuṣyeṣu bhūyāsam
verses.en: His herald rays are seen afar refulgent o'er the world of men, Like flames of fire that burn and blaze. Taken upon a base art thou. For Surya, for the Bright One, thee. This is thy home. For Surya, for the Bright One, thee. Thou among Gods art brightest, brightest Surya. Among mankind I fain would be the brightest.

verses.sa: उदु त्यं जातवेदसं देवं वहन्ति केतवः। दृशे विश्वाय सूर्यम्। उपयामगृहीतोऽसि सूर्याय त्वा भ्राजायैष ते योनिः सूर्याय त्वा भ्राजाय॥
verses.tr: udu tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketavaḥ dṛśe viśvāya sūryam upayāmagṛhīto'si sūryāya tvā bhrājāyaiṣa te yoniḥ sūryāya tvā bhrājāya
verses.en: His herald rays bear him aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, Surya, that all may look at him. Taken upon a base, etc., as in

verses.sa: आ जिघ्र कलशं मह्या त्वा विशन्त्विन्दवः। पुनरूर्जा नि वर्तस्व सा नः सहस्रं धुक्ष्वोरुधारा पयस्वती पुनर्मा विशताद्रयिः॥
verses.tr: ā jighra kalaśaṃ mahyā tvā viśantvindavaḥ punarūrjā ni vartasva sā naḥ sahasraṃ dhukṣvorudhārā payasvatī punarmā viśatādrayiḥ
verses.en: Smell thou the vat. Let Soma drops pass into thee, O Mighty One. Return again with store of sap. Pour for us wealth in thousands thou with full broad streams and floods of milk. Let riches come again to me.

verses.sa: इडे रन्ते हव्ये काम्ये चन्द्रे ज्योतेऽदिते सरस्वति महि विश्रुति। एता ते अघ्न्ये नामानि देवेभ्यो मा सुकृतं ब्रूतात्॥
verses.tr: iḍe rante havye kāmye candre jyote'dite sarasvati mahi viśruti etā te aghnye nāmāni devebhyo mā sukṛtaṃ brūtāt
verses.en: Ida, delightful, worshipful, loveable, splendid, shining One, Inviolable, full of sap, the Mighty One, most glorious. These are thy names, O Cow: tell thou the Gods that I act righteously.

verses.sa: वि न इन्द्र मृधो जहि नीचा यच्छ पृतन्यतः। यो अस्माँ२ अभिदासत्यधरं गमया तमः। उपयामगृहीतोऽसीन्द्राय त्वा विमृधे एष ते योनिरिन्द्राय त्वा विमृधे॥
verses.tr: vi na indra mṛdho jahi nīcā yaccha pṛtanyataḥ yo asmāṃ2 abhidāsatyadharaṃ gamayā tamaḥ upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā vimṛdhe eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā vimṛdhe
verses.en: O Indra, beat our foes away, humble the men who challenge us: Send down to nether darkness him who seeks to do us injury. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra, foe-dispeller, thee. This is thy home. For Indra, foe-dispeller, thee.

verses.sa: वाचस्पतिं विश्वकर्माणमूतये मनोजुवं वाजे अद्या हुवेम। स नो विश्वानि हवनानि जोषद्विश्वशम्भूरवसे साधुकर्मा। उपयामगृहीतोऽसीन्द्राय त्वा विश्वकर्मणे एष ते योनिरिन्द्राय त्वा विश्वकर्मणे॥
verses.tr: vācaspatiṃ viśvakarmāṇamūtaye manojuvaṃ vāje adyā huvema sa no viśvāni havanāni joṣadviśvaśambhūravase sādhukarmā upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā viśvakarmaṇe eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā viśvakarmaṇe
verses.en: Let us invoke to-day, to aid our labour, the Lord of Speech, the thought-swift Visvakarman. May he hear kindly all our invocations, who gives all bliss for aid, whose works are righteous. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra Visvakarman thee. This is thy home. For Indra Visvakarman thee.

verses.sa: विश्वकर्मन् हविषा वर्धनेन त्रातारमिन्द्रमकृणोरवध्यम्। तस्मै विशः समनमन्त पूर्वीरयमुग्रो विहव्यो यथासत्। उपयामगृहीतोऽसीन्द्राय त्वा विश्वकर्मण एष ते योनिरिन्द्राय त्वा विश्वकर्मणे॥
verses.tr: viśvakarman haviṣā vardhanena trātāramindramakṛṇoravadhyam tasmai viśaḥ samanamanta pūrvīrayamugro vihavyo yathāsat upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā viśvakarmaṇa eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā viśvakarmaṇe
verses.en: With strengthening libation, Visvakarman, thou madest Indra an undying guardian. The people of old time bowed down before him because the Mighty One was meet for worship. Taken upon a base, etc., as in

verses.sa: उपयामगृहीतोऽस्यग्नये त्वा गायत्रच्छन्दसं गृह्णामीन्द्राय त्वा त्रिष्टुप्छन्दसं गृह्णामि विश्वेभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्यो जगच्छन्दसं गृह्णाम्यनुष्टुप्तेऽभिगरः॥
verses.tr: upayāmagṛhīto'syagnaye tvā gāyatracchandasaṃ gṛhṇāmīndrāya tvā triṣṭupchandasaṃ gṛhṇāmi viśvebhyastvā devebhyo jagacchandasaṃ gṛhṇāmyanuṣṭupte'bhigaraḥ
verses.en: Taken upon a base art thou. I take thee lord of Gayatri for Agni. For Indra take I thee the lord of Trishtup. I take thee lord of Jagati for All-Gods. Anushtup is the song that sings thy praises.

verses.sa: व्रेशीनां त्वा पत्मन्ना धूनोमि कुकूननानां त्वा पत्मन्ना धूनोमि भन्दनानां त्वा पत्मन्ना धूनोमि मदिन्तमानां त्वा पत्मन्ना धूनोमि मधुन्तमानां त्वा पत्मन्ना धूनोमि शुक्रं त्वा शुक्र आ धूनोम्यह्नो रूपे सूर्यस्य रश्मिषु॥
verses.tr: vreśīnāṃ tvā patmannā dhūnomi kukūnanānāṃ tvā patmannā dhūnomi bhandanānāṃ tvā patmannā dhūnomi madintamānāṃ tvā patmannā dhūnomi madhuntamānāṃ tvā patmannā dhūnomi śukraṃ tvā śukra ā dhūnomyahno rūpe sūryasya raśmiṣu
verses.en: I stir thee for the fall of cloud-borne waters. I stir thee for the fall of streams that gurgle. I stir thee for the fall of those that gladden. I stir thee for their fall who are most lovely. I stir thee for their fall that are, the sweetest. I stir thee for the waters' fall, I stir thee, pure one, in the pure, in the day's form, in Surya's beams.

verses.sa: ककुभं रूपं वृषभस्य रोचते बृहच्छुक्रः शुक्रस्य पुरोगाः सोमः सोमस्य पुरोगाः। यत्ते सोमादाभ्यं नाम जागृवि तस्मै त्वा गृह्णामि तस्मै ते सोम सोमाय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: kakubhaṃ rūpaṃ vṛṣabhasya rocate bṛhacchukraḥ śukrasya purogāḥ somaḥ somasya purogāḥ yatte somādābhyaṃ nāma jāgṛvi tasmai tvā gṛhṇāmi tasmai te soma somāya svāhā
verses.en: The Bull's majestic form is shining brightly, the pure the pure's preceder, Soma Soma's. Whatever name invincible, stimulating, is thine, O Soma, for that name I take thee. All-hail to Soma, unto thee, Soma.

verses.sa: उशिक् त्वं देव सोमाग्नेः प्रियं पाथोऽपीहि वशी त्वं देव सोमेन्द्रस्य प्रियं पाथोऽपीह्यस्मत्सखा त्वं देव सोम विश्वेषां देवानां प्रियं पाथोऽपीहि॥
verses.tr: uśik tvaṃ deva somāgneḥ priyaṃ pātho'pīhi vaśī tvaṃ deva somendrasya priyaṃ pātho'pīhyasmatsakhā tvaṃ deva soma viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ priyaṃ pātho'pīhi
verses.en: O radiant Soma, eagerly draw nigh to Agni's well-loved food. O radiant Soma, willingly go to the food that Indra loves. Go, radiant Soma, as our friend, to the All-Gods' beloved food.

verses.sa: इह रतिरिह रमध्वमिह धृतिरिह स्वधृतिः स्वाहा। उपसृजन् धरुणं मात्रे धरुणो मातरं धयन्। रायस्पोषमस्मासु दीधरत्स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: iha ratiriha ramadhvamiha dhṛtiriha svadhṛtiḥ svāhā upasṛjan dharuṇaṃ mātre dharuṇo mātaraṃ dhayan rāyaspoṣamasmāsu dīdharatsvāhā
verses.en: Here is delight: enjoy yourselves; here surety, surety of your own. All-hail! Loosing the suckling to his dam, the suckling as he milks his dam—May he maintain the growth of wealth among us. All-hail!

verses.sa: सत्रस्य ऋद्धिरस्यगन्म ज्योतिरमृता अभूम। दिवं पृथिव्या अध्याऽरुहामाविदाम देवान्त्स्वर्ज्योतिः॥
verses.tr: satrasya ṛddhirasyaganma jyotiramṛtā abhūma divaṃ pṛthivyā adhyā'ruhāmāvidāma devāntsvarjyotiḥ
verses.en: Thou art the Session's happy termination. We have attained the light and grown immortal. We have gone up from earth to sky, have found the Gods and heaven and light.

verses.sa: युवं तमिन्द्रापर्वता पुरोयुधा यो नः पृतन्यादप तं तमिद्धतं वज्रेण तं तमिद्धतम्। दूरे चत्ताय छन्त्सद्गहनं यदिनक्षत्। अस्माकं शत्रून्परि शूर विश्वतो दर्मा दर्षीष्ट विश्वतः। भूर्भुवः स्वः सुप्रजाः प्रजाभिः स्याम सुवीरा वीरैः सुपोषाः पोषैः॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ tamindrāparvatā puroyudhā yo naḥ pṛtanyādapa taṃ tamiddhataṃ vajreṇa taṃ tamiddhatam dūre cattāya chantsadgahanaṃ yadinakṣat asmākaṃ śatrūnpari śūra viśvato darmā darṣīṣṭa viśvataḥ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ suprajāḥ prajābhiḥ syāma suvīrā vīraiḥ supoṣāḥ poṣaiḥ
verses.en: Indra and Parvata, our champions in the fight, drive ye away the man who fain would war with us, drive him far from us with the bolt. Welcome to him concealed afar shall be the lair that he hath found. So may the Render rend our foes on every side, rend them, O Hero, everywhere. Earth! Ether! Sky! May we be rich in offspring, rich in brave sons and rich in food to feed us.

verses.sa: परमेष्ठ्यभिधीतः प्रजापतिर्वाचि व्याहृतायामन्धो अच्छेतः। सविता सन्यां विश्वकर्मा दीक्षायां पूषा सोमक्रयण्याम्॥
verses.tr: parameṣṭhyabhidhītaḥ prajāpatirvāci vyāhṛtāyāmandho acchetaḥ savitā sanyāṃ viśvakarmā dīkṣāyāṃ pūṣā somakrayaṇyām
verses.en: Parameshthin when contemplated. Prajapati in uttered speech. Food when approached. Savitar in the partition. Visvakarman in Consecration. Pushan in the Soma-purohasinga' ing cow.

verses.sa: इन्द्रश्च मरुतश्च क्रयायोपोत्थितो ऽसुरः पण्यमानो मित्रः क्रीतो विष्णुः शिपिविष्ट उरावासन्नो विष्णुर्नरन्धिषः॥
verses.tr: indraśca marutaśca krayāyopotthito 'suraḥ paṇyamāno mitraḥ krīto viṣṇuḥ śipiviṣṭa urāvāsanno viṣṇurnarandhiṣaḥ
verses.en: As Indra and the Maruts he is stationed ready for the sale; Asura, being bought and sold. Mitra when purchased; Vishnu Sipivishta when oh the Sacrificers thigh he resteth; Vishnu Narandhisha brought on the barrow;

verses.sa: प्रोह्यमाणः सोम आगतो वरुण आसन्द्यामासन्नो ऽग्निराग्नीध्र इन्द्रो हविर्धाने ऽथर्वोपावह्रियमाणः॥
verses.tr: prohyamāṇaḥ soma āgato varuṇa āsandyāmāsanno 'gnirāgnīdhra indro havirdhāne 'tharvopāvahriyamāṇaḥ
verses.en: Soma when come: when seated on the platform, Varuna; Agni in the sacred fire-place; Indra upon the sacrificial barrow; Atharvan when deposited for pounding;

verses.sa: विश्वे देवा अंशुषु न्युप्तो विष्णुराप्रीतपा आप्याय्यमानो यमः सूयमा नो विष्णुः सम्भ्रियमाणो वायुः पूयमानः शुक्रः पूतः शुक्रः क्षीरश्रीर्मन्थी सक्तुश्रीः॥
verses.tr: viśve devā aṃśuṣu nyupto viṣṇurāprītapā āpyāyyamāno yamaḥ sūyamā no viṣṇuḥ sambhriyamāṇo vāyuḥ pūyamānaḥ śukraḥ pūtaḥ śukraḥ kṣīraśrīrmanthī saktuśrīḥ
verses.en: All-Gods when offered in the scattered fragments; Vishnu, the guard of those who soothe his anger, when he is filled and swelling in the waters; Yama in pressing; Vishnu in collection; Vayu what time they cleanse and purify him; the Bright when cleansed; the Bright with milk about him; Manthin commingled with the meal of barley;

verses.sa: विश्वे देवाश्चमसेषून्नीतो ऽसुर्होमायोद्यतो रुद्रो हूयमानो वातोऽभ्यावृत्तो नृचक्षाः प्रतिख्यातो भक्षो भक्ष्यमाणः पितरो नाराशंसाः॥
verses.tr: viśve devāścamaseṣūnnīto 'surhomāyodyato rudro hūyamāno vāto'bhyāvṛtto nṛcakṣāḥ pratikhyāto bhakṣo bhakṣyamāṇaḥ pitaro nārāśaṃsāḥ
verses.en: All-Gods when he is drawn away in beakers; Life when up-lifted for the fire-oblation; Rudra when offered; Vrata when reverted; Man-viewer when beheld; drink when they drink him; deposited, the Narasamsa Fathers;

verses.sa: सन्नः सिन्धुरवभृथायोद्यतः समुद्रोऽभ्यवह्रियमाणः सलिलः प्रप्लुतो ययोरोजसा स्कभिता रजांसि वीर्येभिर्वीरतमा शविष्ठा। या पत्येते अप्रतीता सहोभिर्विष्णू अगन्वरुणा पूर्वहूतौ॥
verses.tr: sannaḥ sindhuravabhṛthāyodyataḥ samudro'bhyavahriyamāṇaḥ salilaḥ prapluto yayorojasā skabhitā rajāṃsi vīryebhirvīratamā śaviṣṭhā yā patyete apratītā sahobhirviṣṇū aganvaruṇā pūrvahūtau
verses.en: Sindhu when ready for the bath that cleanses; the sea when he is carried to the waters; Water is he when he is plunged beneath it. To those most mighty hath it gone, most manly in vigour, by whose strength the worlds were stablished, Who rule as Lords resistless in their grandeur, Vishnu and Varuna, at the prayer of morning.

verses.sa: देवान्दिवमगन्यज्ञस्ततो मा द्रविणमष्टु मनुष्यानन्तरिक्षमगन्यज्ञस्ततो मा द्रविणमष्टु पितॄन्पृथिवीमगन्यज्ञस्ततो मा द्रविणमष्टु यं कं च लोकमगन्यज्ञस्ततो मे भद्रंमभूत्॥
verses.tr: devāndivamaganyajñastato mā draviṇamaṣṭu manuṣyānantarikṣamaganyajñastato mā draviṇamaṣṭu pitṝnpṛthivīmaganyajñastato mā draviṇamaṣṭu yaṃ kaṃ ca lokamaganyajñastato me bhadraṃmabhūt
verses.en: To Gods, to sky the sacrifice hath gone: come riches thence to me! To men, to air the sacrifice hath gone: come riches thence to me! Fathers, earth, the sacrifice hath gone: come riches thence to me! Whatever sphere the sacrifice hath reached, may wealth come thence to me.

verses.sa: चतुस्त्रिंशत्तन्तवो ये वितत्निरे य इमं यज्ञं स्वधया ददन्ते। तेषां छिन्नं सम्वेतद्दधामि स्वाहा घर्मो अप्येतु देवान्॥
verses.tr: catustriṃśattantavo ye vitatnire ya imaṃ yajñaṃ svadhayā dadante teṣāṃ chinnaṃ samvetaddadhāmi svāhā gharmo apyetu devān
verses.en: The threads that have been spun, the four-and-thirty, which stablish this our sacrifice with Svadha, Of these I join together what is broken. All>hail! to Gods go the warm milk oblation!

verses.sa: यज्ञस्य दोहो विततः पुरुत्रा सो अष्टधा दिवमन्वाततान। स यज्ञ धुक्ष्व महि मे प्रजा यां रायस्पोषं विश्वमायुरशीय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yajñasya doho vitataḥ purutrā so aṣṭadhā divamanvātatāna sa yajña dhukṣva mahi me prajā yāṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ viśvamāyuraśīya svāhā
verses.en: Spread far and wide is sacrifice's milking: eightfold along the heaven hath it extended. Pour, Sacrifice! in plenty on mine offspring: may I obtain prosperity for ever. All-hail!

verses.sa: आ पवस्व हिरण्यवदश्ववत्सोम वीरवत्। वाजं गोमन्तमा भर स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ā pavasva hiraṇyavadaśvavatsoma vīravat vājaṃ gomantamā bhara svāhā
verses.en: Soma, send wealth in gold and steeds and heroes. All-hail! Bring hitherward booty in cattle.
